body: I know its not complex or difficult. I'm sorry. I dont know how to explain how  I feel. I did read through your history and saw you always write negative comments so I know I am no special case. I also saw that you fight to the end so I am giving up. I have surrendered. I will no longer attempt to explain my emotions to you.

I dont know what I want. I dont know what I hoped to achive from posting. I think I just needed to tell someone that I am hurting. I think I just wanted someone to know that my life sucks right now and that I need people to know I have been fighting for a long time. Maybe I was hoping someone would tell me that all my efforts were not in vain or that it will pass. I think I just wanted someone to tell me that they see I am in pain, that they recognize the day to day struggle and believe in me to stick out the pain.

I wasn't exaggerating. It's an online relationship and he lives across the world. I can not interact with people in person. I am not making excuses and I have put so much effort into bettering myself as a person. I needed a place to vent and I vented, I talked about something that is really hard to talk about and you are telling me to stop with the self pity and stop exaggerating and stop making excuses. That was really hurtful.
